deployments_detail.use: Microsoft 365 Copilot rolled out at Asahi Europe & International for employee productivity: meeting minutes, document summarization, HR interview-question drafting (cut from 3 days to 1 hour), and multilingual (14-language) communications; also experimenting with Copilot Studio conversational agents for 24/7 HR support and customer ordering. [Microsoft (Copilot for Microsoft 365 E3, Copilot Studio)]
deployments_detail.value: Started with 300 Copilot licenses; leadership estimates ~15% of time previously spent on admin tasks freed up

deployments_detail.use: Asahi Group Holdings launched a project to incorporate generative AI into business systems to improve operational efficiency and enable autonomous operational changes, as stated in its Japan Business Strategy investor presentation. [none]
"Asahi Chat" (GPT-4) internal AI + generative-AI internal info search (Azure OpenAI, from Sep 2023)

AI-powered recommendation and matching engine for Asahi Beer built by Smartdev/Verysell AI, providing user matching on behavioral patterns, personalized drink-recipe suggestions and semantic similarity (embeddings) search across Asahi's digital platforms. [Smartdev / Verysell AI]
AI demand forecasting (reduce order errors/waste) + consumer insight analysis

AI-enabled Trade Promotion Optimization (TPO) tool co-designed with EY, with descriptive, predictive and prescriptive capabilities analyzing RGM data, POS, weather and trading restrictions to optimize promotional spend and forecast revenue; delivered via EY Managed Services on Microsoft Azure and integrated with SAP. [EY + Microsoft Azure (EY RGM framework / consumer commercial analytics platform)]
deployments_detail.value: Deployed across five European markets; daily tool usage growing 60% year-on-year; Romania team analyzed hundreds of promotions with full recommendations in 24 hours

deployments_detail.use: AI Creator System, described as the world's first automatic package-design generation system, combining multiple deep-learning models to generate original package design proposals and a design-evaluation engine that scores designs, jointly developed with Cogent Labs. [Cogent Labs]
deployments_detail.value: Evaluation engine trained on inputs from ~300 design experts across 3,000 images; trial service began April 2020

deployments_detail.use: Asahi Beverages (Australia) selected Complexica's Decision Cloud platform (Larry, the Digital Analyst and Promotional Campaign Manager) for AI-driven trade promotion optimization, following a proof-of-concept, to optimize promotions on volume, margin and net price realization and generate what-if scenarios. [Complexica (Decision Cloud, Larry the Digital Analyst)]

Asahi Lifestyle Beverages (Asahi Beverages' non-alcoholic drinks business in Australia) went live with the Trade Promotion Management and Optimisation modules of Complexica's AI Decision Cloud to automate what-if scenario exploration and save time for Sales and Revenue Management teams. [Complexica (Decision Cloud)]

Asahi Beverages' digital and data team uses Mutinex GrowthOS, an AI/econometric marketing mix modeling platform, to analyze marketing channel performance against sales and revenue and guide media investment decisions. [Mutinex (GrowthOS)]

Asahi Beverages (Australia) has started embedding Salesforce Agentforce agentic AI into sales and marketing processes as part of a shift to real-time, data-driven territory sales planning across a ~300-person field sales team serving ~30,000 customers. [Salesforce (Agentforce)]
deployments_detail.value: 300-person field sales team; ~30,000 customers; consolidating from 60 CRM systems
